contrast.rule/ground: 2.5:1 — a decorative grid hairline, lifted from #332F29 for projector legibility; not a text pairing

display.purpose: One headline number per detail panel — affinity, final score, record count. Never two in a panel.

headline.purpose: The wordmark and the four live legend counts; read first and from furthest away.

title.purpose: View headings and detail-column headings, uppercase.

body.purpose: Running prose, table cells, row values. Explanatory paragraphs cap at 46ch.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, units, legend labels, tags. Uppercase, widely tracked.

nav.purpose: The left rail's five work-area labels.

data.purpose: SMILES, SHA-256 digests, addresses, indices — anything to be read character by character.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system has no drop shadows, blurs or glows. Depth is tonal (three near-black grounds) plus hairline rules.

shadows.name: ring-selected-cell
shadows.purpose: The chosen candidate in the chart, drawn on a pseudo-element so layout never shifts.

shadows.name: ring-active-stage
shadows.purpose: The live category filter in the legend bar; the block keeps its hue.

shadows.name: ring-neutral-tag
shadows.purpose: Edges the unclassified tag without a fill that would read as a fifth category.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The single focus treatment for every interactive element in the system.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: settle 0.34s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both — from { opacity: 0.35; transform: translateY(5px) }
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance. Candidate cells arrive from an already-visible default on an exponential ease-out, staggered 10ms per cell and capped at the 40th.

motion.name: sweep
motion.value: sweep 1.1s ease-in-out infinite — translateX(-100%) to translateX(380%)
motion.purpose: Functional progress feedback on a 3px track while model inference runs; inference takes seconds to tens of seconds, so the bar is content.

motion.name: step
motion.purpose: The shared state transition for every hover, filter and selection change.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .cell { animation: none } .bar i { animation: none; width: 100% } * { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important } }
motion.purpose: Complete reduced-motion block: entrance removed, sweep frozen to a full bar, transitions collapsed.

browserSurfaces.name: scrollbar
browserSurfaces.value: ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 11px; height: 11px } ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--ground) } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--rule-2); border: 3px solid var(--ground) } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--ink-3) } * { scrollbar-color: var(--rule-2) var(--ground); scrollbar-width: thin }

browserSurfaces.name: caret
browserSurfaces.value: input, select, button, textarea { caret-color: var(--gen) }

atomPalette.purpose: Fixed element colours for the bundled 2D structure renderer, drawn on a transparent background so the cell's ground shows through.
atomPalette.drawing: bondThickness 1.1, bondLength 15, padding 4, terminalCarbons off, explicitHydrogens off, compactDrawing off

offline.note: Both faces are self-hosted woff2 (weight 400–700, font-display swap) and preloaded; the structure renderer is bundled by Vite. Nothing essential is fetched from a CDN, because the demo may run with no network.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one bright action in a panel — Generate, Run pipeline, Screen, Store on chain.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #F2EFE6); background: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); color: var(--ground, #12110F); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--gen, #E4C200); border-color: var(--gen, #E4C200); color: var(--gen-ink, #12110F); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gen, #E4C200); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions — clear filter, tamper, verify, record on chain. Inverts to a bone fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #F2EFE6); background: none; color: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); color: var(--ground, #12110F); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gen, #E4C200); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Legend Stage Block
components.description: Signature. Four equal blocks span the top bar, each entirely filled with its category colour, each a live filter over the candidate chart. The active one keeps its hue and gains a 4px inset bone ring plus a currentColor underline.
components.css: .ds-legend { display: flex; min-height: 74px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #F2EFE6); } .ds-stage { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; border: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--ground, #12110F); padding: 10px 16px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; position: relative; border-radius: 0; transition: box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), filter 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-stage:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-stage:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gen, #E4C200); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-stage-gen { background: var(--gen, #E4C200); color: var(--gen-ink, #12110F); } .ds-stage-bind { background: var(--bind, #1E6FD9); color: var(--bind-ink, #FFFFFF); } .ds-stage-tox { background: var(--tox, #C8402F); color: var(--tox-ink, #FFFFFF); } .ds-stage-rank { background: var(--rank, #2A7F52); color: var(--rank-ink, #FFFFFF); } .ds-stage-on { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--ink, #F2EFE6); } .ds-stage-on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 6px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; } .ds-stage-count { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stage-label { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Candidate Cell
components.description: Signature. The wall chart's unit: no fill at rest, hairline right and bottom rules, identical furniture in identical positions, and a 6px verdict bar flush along the bottom edge in the colour of the furthest stage reached.
components.css: .ds-chart { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(112px, 1fr)); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #5A5349); border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #5A5349); } .ds-cell { position: relative; border: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule, #5A5349); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #5A5349); border-radius: 0; padding: 7px 8px 13px; min-height: 132px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-cell:hover { background: var(--ground-2, #1A1916); } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gen, #E4C200); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cell-sel { background: var(--ground-3, #221F1B); } .ds-cell-sel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #F2EFE6); pointer-events: none; } .ds-cell-idx { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3, #9D978A); letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-cell-score { position: absolute; top: 7px; right: 8px; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cell-struct { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 62px; padding: 3px 0; } .ds-cell-formula { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2, #B8B3A4); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-cell-verdict { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 6px; background: var(--rule-2, #7A7163); } .ds-v-bind { background: var(--bind, #1E6FD9); } @keyframes ds-settle { from { opacity: 0.35; transform: translateY(5px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } .ds-cell { animation: ds-settle 0.34s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cell { animation: none; } }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Every control in the panel row: an uppercase ash label stacked over a square charcoal field with a hairline border and monospace value text.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-field > span { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #9D978A); } .ds-field input { background: var(--ground-2, #1A1916); border: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #7A7163); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; min-width: 0; caret-color: var(--gen, #E4C200); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #9D978A); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gen, #E4C200); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #9D978A); }

components.name: Nav Rail
components.description: The left rail's five work areas. Drawn 18px icons at 1.6 stroke beside condensed uppercase labels; the active item fills chrome yellow, the same accent every live control uses.
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 190px; border-right: 2px solid var(--ink, #F2EFE6); padding-top: 14px; } .ds-rail-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 11px 16px; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink-2, #B8B3A4); font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: var(--ground-2, #1A1916); color: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gen, #E4C200); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-on { background: var(--gen, #E4C200); color: var(--gen-ink, #12110F); font-weight: 700; } .ds-rail-item svg { flex: none; }

components.name: Verdict Tag
components.description: The verdict column in every table. Solid category colour, square, one per row. The neutral variant is warm charcoal with a hairline inset ring, so 'not classified' never reads as a fifth category.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-tag-gen { background: var(--gen, #E4C200); color: var(--gen-ink, #12110F); } .ds-tag-none { background: var(--ground-3, #221F1B); color: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-2, #7A7163); }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The tabular view used by Binding, Toxicity, Pipeline and Ledger. Sticky uppercase ash headers over hairline-divided rows; figures set in condensed 700 so numbers outweigh their labels.
components.css: .ds-tbl { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tbl th { text-align: left; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #9D978A); padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #7A7163); background: var(--ground, #12110F); position: sticky; top: 0; } .ds-tbl td { padding: 11px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #5A5349); font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); } .ds-tbl tbody tr:hover { background: var(--ground-2, #1A1916); } .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-num { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }

components.name: Detail Figure
components.description: The detail column's headline number at 62px, with its uppercase unit beneath. When there is no value yet it states so in words at 21px — an em-dash at display size reads as a white bar, not as an absent number.
components.html:
9.04
KIBA affinity
Nothing scored yet
Strong binders
components.css: .ds-figure { margin-bottom: 20px; color: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); } .ds-figure-n { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 62px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-figure-none { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-3, #9D978A); letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-figure-u { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #9D978A); margin-top: 3px; }

components.name: Note and Progress Bar
components.description: Result and error feedback: a charcoal block marked by a single 1px left border, vermilion when it failed and green when it verified. The 3px sweep above it runs while a model is working.
components.html:
Stored. Record #12 in block 48.
Chain unavailable. Could not reach the node.
components.css: .ds-note { padding: 13px 16px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #7A7163); background: var(--ground-2, #1A1916); color: var(--ink-2, #B8B3A4); margin: 18px 0; } .ds-note strong { color: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); font-weight: 600; } .ds-note-err { border-left-color: var(--tox, #C8402F); color: var(--ink, #F2EFE6); } .ds-bar { height: 3px; background: var(--rule-2, #7A7163); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--gen, #E4C200); width: 36%; animation: ds-sweep 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-sweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%); } 100% { transform: translateX(380%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-bar i { animation: none; width: 100%; } }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Every empty region says what to do next: a 21px uppercase condensed heading over a 46ch paragraph. Never a bare 'no data'.
components.html:
No candidates yet

Generate a batch to populate the chart. Each molecule becomes a cell; its colour bar records how far it travelled through the pipeline.
components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 50px 22px; color: var(--ink-3, #9D978A); text-align: center; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-empty h3 { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #B8B3A4); margin: 0; } .ds-empty p { max-width: 46ch; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Pharma-Z is a wall chart, not a dashboard. Two thousand candidates are classified at once on a single near-black field, and the classification *is* the layout: a flat category colour tells you how far a molecule travelled through the pipeline, and the grid of cells is the argument. Nothing floats on a card. There is no stat row hovering above a table, because that arrangement separates the number from the molecule that produced it.

The material is unmodulated. No gradient appears anywhere in the system, no surface is rounded, and depth is carried entirely by three near-black grounds and a hairline grid. Colour is never an accent sprinkled on grey — each of the four category colours fills a whole legend block edge to edge, and the same colour reappears as a 6px bar, a stage marker, and a table tag so a viewer learns the code once. Condensed grotesk at wall-chart density does the rest: tight, capitalised, numeric, with tabular figures so columns of scores line up as a reading surface.

Everything is sized for a projector in a lit room, not for a laptop at arm's length. That single constraint set the hairline rules a step brighter than on-screen taste would choose, pushed the muted inks up the contrast scale, and darkened the ranked green one step so white ink on it clears 4.5:1. The surface also ships self-contained — both typefaces and the 2D structure renderer are bundled, because the demo may run with no network at the moment of truth.
keyCharacteristics: Classification by colour: four category colours each own a pipeline stage.
Flat and unmodulated — zero gradients, zero corner radii, no drop shadows.
Hairline grid rules carry the chart; cells have no fill at rest.
Condensed grotesk at wall-chart density with tabular figures throughout.
Browser chrome is themed, not inherited: selection, scrollbar, caret, focus.
One authored entrance moment; everything else is a 0.18s state transition.
Self-hosted faces and a bundled renderer — the whole surface works offline.

rules.name: The Classification Rule
rules.body: A category colour means one pipeline stage, everywhere it appears — legend block, 6px cell verdict bar, table tag, pipeline stage marker. A category colour is never used for emphasis, mood, or ornament.

rules.name: The Region Rule
rules.body: Colour owns whole regions. A category colour fills a block, a bar, or a tag; it is not an outline on a grey card or a dot beside a label. The only non-region uses in the system are the 1px coloured left border on a result note and a single coloured number or verdict word in the detail column.

rules.name: The Paired Ink Rule
rules.body: Every category colour has a paired ink token chosen to clear 4.5:1 on it, and coloured regions use that pairing: near-black on yellow (10.8:1), white on cobalt (4.85:1), vermilion (4.96:1) and green (4.93:1). The ranked green ships at one step darker than the hue first committed precisely to make that pairing clear.

rules.name: The Projector Rule
rules.body: Hairline rules and muted inks are set for legibility at projector distance, not for on-screen subtlety. A rule that looks slightly too present on a laptop is correct; one that disappears in a lit room is not.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is set on the body and inherited everywhere. Numbers in a column line up by digit; a score that shifts as it updates is a bug.

rules.name: The One Big Number Rule
rules.body: The 62px display size is reserved for the single most consequential figure in a panel. When that figure has no value yet, the panel says so in words at 21px — an em-dash at display size reads as a white bar, not as an absent number.

rules.name: The Machine-String Rule
rules.body: Anything the machine produced verbatim — SMILES, SHA-256 digests, wallet addresses, assay names — is set in the data face. Prose about them is not.

rules.name: The Fixed Furniture Rule
rules.body: Every cell carries the same four facts in the same four positions — index top-left, score top-right, structure centred, formula along the bottom, verdict bar on the bottom edge. A molecule that could not be parsed still fills all five slots. Comparison across the chart must cost no eye travel.

rules.name: The Flat Material Rule
rules.body: No gradient, no drop shadow, no blur, no glow, ever. If something needs to come forward, it changes ground tone or gains a ring.

rules.name: The One Entrance Rule
rules.body: settle is the system's only authored entrance: 0.34s on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) from an already-visible default (opacity 0.35, 5px down), staggered 10ms per cell and capped at the 40th, so a large batch finishes arriving. Nothing else in the system animates on arrival.

dos: Do let a category colour mean exactly one pipeline stage, in every place it appears.
Do fill whole regions with colour — a block, a 6px bar, a tag — rather than outlining or dotting.
Do use the paired ink token on every coloured region: near-black on yellow, white on cobalt, vermilion and green.
Do keep every corner square (0 radius) and every surface flat.
Do carry structure with the two-weight border vocabulary: 2px bone for shell divisions, 1px hairline inside.
Do set every machine-produced string in the monospace data face, and keep tabular-nums on everything numeric.
Do reserve the 62px display size for one figure per panel, and write words rather than an em-dash when that figure has no value yet.
Do theme the browser's own surfaces — selection, scrollbar, caret, focus ring — rather than inheriting defaults.
Do show what is running and on how many molecules; latency is content.
Do bundle every font and renderer the surface needs. The demo may be offline.
Do keep every cell's furniture identical and in identical positions.
donts: Don't use a gradient, a drop shadow, a blur or a glow anywhere. Flat inset rings are the only box-shadow this system permits.
Don't introduce a fifth category colour, or reuse an existing one for emphasis, mood or ornament.
Don't set category colour as small body text or as a thin outline on a grey surface — at these hues that lands near 3.8:1 on the ground and the system's own paired-ink pairing is the correct device.
Don't darken the hairline rules for on-screen subtlety; they are tuned for projector distance.
Don't put stat cards above a table, or let a number appear detached from the molecule that produced it.
Don't use a glyph, emoji or icon font. Icons are drawn at 18px / 1.6 stroke.
Don't add a second entrance animation, or animate anything on arrival other than the candidate cells.
Don't fetch a font, an icon set or a renderer from a CDN.
Don't show a bare empty state; say what to do next.
